letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Junior Software Engineer role with Example Hiring Team. With a BSc in Computer Science, I am transitioning from programme coordination into software engineering, supported by hands-on work with TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Git.

My most relevant project is Booking Lab, an independent appointment scheduler built with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. I implemented persistent storage and automated tests for booking conflicts, documented the tradeoff between database constraints and application validation, and provided a reproducible local demo. This gives me relevant foundations for your Node.js testing needs, although my record does not yet establish specific API-testing experience.

Accessibility has also shaped my previous work. As Programme Coordinator at Example Community Centre, I collected accessibility feedback from participants and recorded issues for the programme team. Combined with my React experience, this would help me approach accessible interface work thoughtfully. I would, however, want to discuss the role's accessibility standards and testing practices because I have not claimed a completed accessible React interface.

My coordination background includes handling appointment schedules, documenting booking-conflict resolution, and communicating recorded issues to colleagues. I now apply a similarly structured approach to software development through automated testing, technical tradeoff documentation, and reproducible setup instructions.

I want to be transparent that Kubernetes operations are not represented in my current experience. I would welcome the chance to develop that capability while contributing through the documented skills and project work above.

Thank you for considering my application. I would value the opportunity to discuss how my software project, Computer Science studies, and coordination experience could support your team.

Kind regards,
Zoë Șerban
questions: Has Zoë tested Node.js APIs specifically? If so, which tools, test types, and project examples can be documented?
Did Booking Lab include accessibility implementation or testing, such as semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, or assistive-technology checks?
Does Zoë have any Kubernetes training, coursework, personal projects, or operational experience that can be added to the master record?
When document rendering is permitted, does the compact CV fit within one to two A4 pages without clipping, missing glyphs, or crowded page breaks?
